answer: The Free plan supports a maximum of 3 members and provides 1 GB of workspace storage. Additionally, it does not include API access [PLAN-01].

Yes, you are eligible for a refund since you are within the 14-day window from your first annual subscription charge, which is 336 hours. To request the refund, please send an email to billing@clouddesk.example, including your workspace ID and invoice number. Remember that the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 5-10 business days once approved. Note that cancellation of renewal does not automatically submit a refund request [BILL-01].
The policy does not specify the backup retention duration. For confirmation on this detail, you would need to contact support directly [DATA-02].
